Class Unlocks

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Unlocks
public final class Unlocks extends Object
Town unlocks: features a server can switch on as its town grows, such as savings interest once a bank is built. A plugin that has such a feature describes it with describe(Unlocks.Feature) and asks isOn(String) before using it. A plugin that decides what is unlocked (Tempest Town, or yours) sets a Unlocks.Provider. 
Unlocks.describe(new Unlocks.Feature("coins:bank_interest", "Bank savings interest",
        Message.translation("server.coins.unlock.interest"), "Coin_Gold"));
if (Unlocks.isOn("coins:bank_interest")) { payInterest(); }

Without a provider every feature is on, so a server without Tempest Town works as before and each plugin's own settings decide. With one, the provider decides; a feature it has no answer for stays on. Asked from any thread, often: answers come from memory.

      public static boolean isOn(String featureId)
      Whether the feature may be used now. On without a provider and when no provider has an answer; off when any provider says off. A provider that throws counts as no answer.

    • isUnlocked

      public static boolean isUnlocked(String featureId)
      True only when a provider has unlocked the feature (and none locks it): for bonuses that a town must give, never on by themselves. Without a provider, or when no provider names it, false. Since API_VERSION 16.
